didacticRJudgments.judgment: The original competency explicitly offers movements, sight lines and shadows as examples. Constructing a line/plane model, solving an intersection and interpreting a finite hit does not universally require selecting and applying a shortest-distance method. Removing the distance branch corrects preparation independently of any desired completion count. Retain line–plane intersection preparation; do not require the learner to solve every example family.

A pair of already specified planes can be intersected in a purely geometric setting. Formulating a real-world model and interpreting a shadow/motion scenario are not universal preparation for obtaining its full intersection line. Retain the original line representation, coordinate-plane representation and plane-form conversion preparation. This correction is necessary before the genuine existing-exam link can be considered; the old full modelling/distance branch remains visible in the original context.

The exact original contract concerns line–plane and plane–plane angles with an additional parameter. A complete prior study of two-line position (including skewness) is not universal preparation for those configurations. The already-authored nonparameter line–plane angle competency is genuine preparation before investigating how that angle depends on a parameter. Keep line–plane position and plane–plane angle preparation. This does not turn every OR-listed requested condition into a separate assessment requirement.

The entire unchanged existing form starts by deriving all common points of two nonparallel planes as a parameter line, checking both equations and explaining the intersection. That action genuinely uses the intersection-line competency as preparation, not as an unrelated coverage label. Part A cannot be replaced by the B/C parallel/identity cases: its original missing-line cap restricts the entire score to at most20/23, below21. Its original method comparison remains. After the independently justified 857 preparation correction, the complete raw and actual effective added preparation consists only of857 in each of the88 existing selected exam scopes. This is a globally genuine didactic link; the72 context-only additions are preparation, not new target enrollment or an extra protected exam. Fresh materialized/runtime verification remains later Root-owned work.

perGoalWholeReuseJudgments.judgment: Solardach genuinely contains line/plane modelling and a shadow, so it was read whole. Its unchanged ordinary8/15 pass can be reached by parts1 and3 (10 points) while omitting the entire ray model and shadow interpretation. The other two forms give their line/plane equations and do not require constructing both models from a real scene. A new complete modelling form protects that core action. No every-example-family coverage demand is imposed.

8d3 already evaluates the actual full intersection line, checks and geometry, alongside its own full parallel/identity and method-choice contract. It is protected in all16 real857 target scopes. The plane-family form also genuinely calculates a line but adds a harder parameter-family obligation; it is not imposed alongside the simpler already selected8d3. No new intersection task, replacement score or changed coverage is authored.

The full coordinate-trace task includes the key contained/parallel plane cases but no relationship to coordinate axes. The line-family form compares lines, including an axis, but never investigates coordinate-plane position. The original exact competency joins axes and planes. Adding the full special-position competency as a global prerequisite to a task that only uses one side would create unrelated preparation. A unified new form assesses the connected axis/plane reasoning with one total pass.

The current canonical edge5f90→bda6 is real preparation. If the new parameter form is later selected as protected in the20 existing overlapping T scopes, its mastery ends that preparation demand; no bda6 mastery is inferred. A merely context/POnly or ordinary5f90 does not count as a selected protected obligation. A separate bda6 content option is supplied for the8 actual bda6 targets without5f90 target, with no duplicate protected pass recommended in the20 overlaps. Solardach assesses a line–plane angle, and338 assesses a line–line angle; neither silently substitutes for this exact two-plane competency.

The existing full plane-/line-family forms calculate parameter-dependent position but no parameter-dependent angle in both specified configuration types. Solardach computes a single constant line–plane angle. The new form derives the two appropriate all-parameter angle quotients, solves two concrete angle conditions, and interprets a true parallel case without requiring all OR-listed condition variants as independent passes.

The first two complete existing forms use a scalar quadratic height-versus-distance function, not an actual spatial trajectory parameterisation and its motion parameter. The drone form has an actual time vector but only a straight line. Their titles or shared ball context do not supply the missing quadratic spatial parameter action. The new form builds the vector path, interprets time and domains and compares an equivalent running parameter; no new memory-card obligation is invented.
